requested_outcome: Every relevant VII place page uses the verified hierarchy Home, World, Region, City, Place; all known search pages, canonical URLs, sitemaps and legacy redirects remain complete and correct; the exact verified candidate is published and rechecked on the public site.
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co across all public place, search and legacy redirect families
authorization_boundary: Implementation, publication to the existing VII Sites project and public verification are explicitly authorized. DNS cutover, fabricated geography and unrelated blocked map-snapshot work are excluded.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Spa or event detail still omits the city because the resolver prefers the region.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Build one ordered geographic breadcrumb resolver that deduplicates only identical verified levels.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Representative and catalog-wide place cases emit Region before City before Place in UI and BreadcrumbList.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A breadcrumb city link leads to a query-only, missing or unrelated search page.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Resolve each crumb through the canonical search-page registry and validate the destination before release.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every generated geographic crumb has an ASCII internal path, 200 destination and matching search state.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The fix changes visible breadcrumbs but leaves structured data, canonical or sitemap inconsistent.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Generate UI and schema from the same hierarchy and run route-level SEO checks.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Visible trail, JSON-LD, H1, canonical and sitemap classification describe the same state.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only a sample of old URLs is checked and a broken 301 remains.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Run the complete stored legacy inventory and publication audits, not a representative sample.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: All 3,526 currently known sources are classified and every enabled redirect is direct, internal, non-homepage and resolves to a 200 self-canonical destination or an explicit gone outcome.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A stale or dirty source overwrites newer public fixes.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use a clean isolated worktree based on the latest approved candidate and exclude uncommitted map work.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Candidate status is clean before freeze, changed-file inventory is scoped and public release identity matches the frozen commit.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The release passes tests but is still wrong on mobile or public production.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Inspect exact public desktop and 390px mobile place/search routes after deployment and retest redirects.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Public screenshots and HTTP evidence show the required hierarchy and no responsive regression.

sources.label: Mature vacation and hourly place hierarchy

midpoint_gate.trigger: After one shared hierarchy implementation passes vacation, hourly, spa and events plus one end-to-end legacy redirect, before broad release audit.
checks: ordered region and city with duplicate suppression
valid canonical city and region destinations
no change to unrelated place-page controls

attack_questions: Can any location-bearing place route still skip a verified region or city?
Can any breadcrumb link return 404, redirect again, use a Hebrew slug or describe a different search state?
Can any active legacy redirect end at the homepage, a non-200 response, a chain or unrelated content?
Can visible breadcrumbs and BreadcrumbList disagree after language change or reload?
Did publication omit a later approved fix or include the blocked map changes?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact public version plus desktop and 390px browser captures and HTTP/JSON-LD checks on representative routes in every affected world.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Complete catalog/source audit for geographic breadcrumbs and complete stored legacy/search-page inventory validators, with explicit counts and zero unresolved enabled mappings.

effectiveness.baseline: Vacation and hourly retain region/city levels, while spa and events use a single resolver that currently prefers area; 3,526 known legacy sources and 2,313 migrated search pages already exist in the candidate.
effectiveness.target: One shared ordered hierarchy with zero missing verified city levels, zero invalid geographic crumb destinations and zero regressions in the complete known redirect/search-page inventories.
